items.title: Chris Parker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 5, 2023
items.q: I listened to that record over and over and over again with Paul Gonsalves, 40 choruses on the blues

ctx.x: I have a feeling, this is just a guess, but that you were aware of almost all that material that you just mentioned by the time you really started playing out. Is that a fair statement?

I didn’t know the Italian words for it, you know musical words, but I knew crescendo and decrescendo and “Dimuendo and Crescendo in Blue” that Duke Ellington tune from a “Live at Newport” concert — you know those are the first two ones that I learned. And I listened to that record over and over and over again with Paul Gonsalves, 40 choruses on the blues, and Jo Jones, you know rapping a newspaper on the stage. That’s a great record. Anyway by the time I was backing up strippers I knew that they have to be…
